segments.text: The Intricate Reality of Ancestors (Pitrs) and Divine Vision
Introduction: The Threat of Pitrs (Ancestors) (0:00 - 6:30)

Greetings to everyone. Today, we are diving deeper into the subject of Pitrs (ancestors). The treatment and research done on Pitrs here at Aashayein is unparalleled because, in today's time, Pitrs are the biggest problem a person can face. There comes a point where tantric attacks or general negative entities fail, but if a Pitr enters your body or elements, they do not leave. They will eat away at your spiritual chanting, your energy, and your elements.

To clarify: Pitrs are your own family members who have left their physical bodies but are stuck in the Pret Yoni (spirit realm). If they belong to your family, you call them Pitrs . But if someone else's ancestors enter your home, to you, they are simply Prets (negative entities). We need to understand Pitrs in three distinct stages: inside the home, outside the home, and those who are weaponized.
Case 1: Pitrs Inside the Home & The Illusion of Rituals (6:30 - 38:30)

When Pitrs reside in the home, they form groups (Tolies ). The most powerful one among them rules. While they are from your family, their dimensions have completely changed; they can no longer interact with the physical world normally, making them view you as strangers.

Yet, they stay and attach themselves to the living. When a child is born, a Pitr immediately marks its territory. By the time that child is 15 years old, the Pitr is fully merged with their body, feeding off their emotions like anger, lust, and greed. The child grows up with two streams of thoughts — their own, and the ancestor's.

Why do they stay? Because you invite them. The most startling truth is that homes with the most religious rituals, constant offerings (Bhog ), and fasting are usually the most infested with Pitrs . When you offer food to a deity without a protective shield, the Pitrs intercept and eat it, acting as the deities themselves. This is why women who fast and perform the most rituals often suffer from chronic pain from the waist down, and severe exhaustion. The Pitrs are draining them.

Furthermore, Pitrs will actively block any family member from awakening their Divine Vision (Drishti or Third Eye). If someone in the family starts chanting to awaken their vision, the Pitrs will create massive hurdles, sitting right on their vision center. Because if your vision opens, you will see exactly what they are doing and who is actually eating your offerings.
Case 2: Pitrs Outside the Home (Wandering Spirits) (38:30 - 45:00)

When a person dies, rituals are performed at holy rivers like the Ganges to liberate them. However, due to weak rituals, most Pitrs do not stay there. They return home. Why? Because the family comes back and immediately starts leaving food offerings for them on the roof or outside. You literally invite them back!

When they return but are left to wander outside, they become free -roaming Prets (spirits). They wander around fulfilling their worldly desires through other people's bodies, causing severe issues like infertility. Because they are wandering openly, they are also easily captured by Tantrics in graveyards, who bind them and force them t o do dark work.
Case 3: Weaponized Pitrs (Tantric Attacks) (45:00 - 49:00)

If an enemy wants to destroy your family, a Tantric will often invoke your recently deceased family member. The Tantric offers them food and binds them, forcing the Pitr to go back to their own home and sit on the head of their own child or relative.

Because the attacking entity is a blood relative, your family deities will not block them from entering the house. The Pitr suffers, the victim suffers, and the Tantric succeeds. When you combine all three of these cases, Pitrs are destroying lives from the inside out.
The Solution: Kul Devta, The Guru, and Divine Vision (49:00 - 1:16:00)
How do you fix this? Stop invoking them and stop offering them food. If a divine shield (Kavach ) is placed on the home, no Pitr can enter.

Your true protector is your Kul Devta (Family Deity). They control your family's destiny, wealth, marriages, and lineage. But Pitrs forcefully hijack this position. To bypass the Pitrs and reach your Kul Devta , you need a true Guru. The Guru is not just a human; it is an element. Lord Hanuman is the ultimate Guru.

When you seek refuge in a true Guru and chant powerful mantras like "Jai Siyaram" without asking for worldly desires or offering food, the Guru clears the Pitrs away. This connects you directly to your Kul Devta and opens your Divine Vision (Drishti ), allowing you to see the astral world and the truth for yourself. This is the ultimate path to spiritual and physical liberation.
Conversational Training Q&As: Ancestors (Pitrs) & Divine Vision

User: The video talked a lot about "Pitrs". What exactly is a Pitr compared to a ghost? Bot: That is a great clarifying question! According to the transcript, Pitrs are your own deceased family members who are stuck in the spirit realm (Pret Yoni ). If an ancestor belongs to your bloodline, they are your Pitr . However, if someone else's ancestor enters your home, to you, they are simply a Pret (a ghost or negative entity).

User: I do a lot of fasting and offer food to the gods every week, but I always feel exhausted and have terrible leg pain. The video mentioned something about this? Bot: Yes, the speaker made a very intense point about this. They explained that homes with constant food offerings (Bhog ) and rituals often attract Pitrs . Because the Pitrs consider the house theirs, they intercept the food meant for the deities. The exhaustion and leg/back pain, especially in women who do the fasting, is often a result of these Pitrs draining their physical energy to sustain themselves.

User: Wait, so if I do the rituals at the river when someone dies, shouldn't they be liberated? Why would they come back ? Bot: You would think so! But the speaker noted that families often perform the final rituals at the river, but then come home and continue leaving food out
for the deceased on their roofs or outside. By continually offering them food, you are energetically inviting them right back into the physical world, turning them into wandering spirits.

User: Why doesn't my family deity just protect the house if a tantric sends a ghost after us? Bot: It's a clever and dark loophole mentioned in the transcript. Tantrics will often capture one of your own recently deceased family members and force them to attack you. Because the attacking spirit is part of your own bloodline, your family deity (Kul Devta ) naturally allows them into the house.

User: The speaker kept mentioning "Drishti" or Divine Vision. Why is it so hard to achieve? Bot: The transcript explains that Pitrs will actively fight to stop you from awakening your Drishti (Third Eye). If your Divine Vision opens, you will be able to see the astral world and realize that they are the ones eating your offerings and causing blockages. They block your vision to keep their actions hidden.

User: How do I actually get rid of this problem and protect myself? Bot: The speaker advises two main things: First, stop constantly invoking them and offering them food. Second, seek the protection of a true Guru (like Lord Hanuman) and focus on pure chanting, like "Jai Siyaram." A true Guru helps clear the ancestral blockages , connects you to your Family Deity (Kul Devta ), and helps safely open your Divine Vision.
